https://docs.example/api/rate-limits:
API Rate Limits - document DOC-88

The default sustained limit is 1000 requests per minute per API key. Short bursts are permitted up to a burst allowance of 50 requests above the sustained rate.

Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Clients should honour Retry-After rather than retrying on a fixed interval.

Limits are per key, not per account. Requesting a higher limit requires a written justification of expected sustained volume.

https://news.example/industry-brief:
Industry Brief BRF-31

Three consolidation moves in the logistics software segment this quarter, all of them mid-market rollups rather than platform acquisitions.

Buyers are paying for installed base rather than technology, which is consistent with the pattern of the previous four quarters.

The segment's renewal rates remain the most reliable public indicator of underlying health; reported growth figures are increasingly inflated by acquisition.
